# U33: A leader acts on what needs them: what threatens the north star, respond to a request, chase a quiet goal, compare in a table

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `EXCEPTIONS-FIRST`, `STORY`, `SAVED-VIEWS`, `ONE-ASK`
- **Budget:** at most 16 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `progress`, `errors` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U33

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- _Note:_ The north star says which contributing goals are most likely to make it miss, near the top.
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Pinned at the top of What feeds it, with why, instead of a second copy above (the flagship page, 5 Nov).
- **Check:** The pinned in the feeds (`#feeds .pinned`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `(await threats.locator('.trow, .gline').count()) > 0 && /Most likely to make it miss/.test(await threats.innerText())`, where `const threats = p.locator('#feeds .pinned')`. Else it says: the north star does not name what threatens it.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “threats”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The goal waiting on Amara's decision: Respond is on its row in Next steps and asks and opens the one Respond panel, ready to answer.
- **Check:** An ask’s row under “Next steps and asks” (`.step-row`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Respond” button in an ask’s row under “Next steps and asks” (`.step-row`).
- **Check:** The “Respond” section shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the “Your answer or decision” field in the “Respond” section is visible (else: Respond does not open a place to answer the request).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `repeats === 0`, where `const repeats = await p.locator('main').evaluate((m) => (m.innerText.match(/Amara Nwosu: Amara/g) || []).length)`. Else it says: the request names its recipient twice.
- _Note:_ Chasing a quiet goal leaves a lasting "Asked" in place of the button: an ask, open until Kojo checks in.
- Go to `/goals/env-search` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Ask Kojo for an update” button.
- **Check:** “Asked Kojo for an update” is shown (else: asking for an update leaves no lasting trace).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “Ask Kojo for an update” button is not visible (else: the ask button is still offered after asking).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `(s1.requests || []).some((r) => r.kind === 'update' && r.goalIds[0] === 'env-search' && r.askedBy === 'amara' && r.status === 'open') && s1.changes.some((c) => c.goalId === 'env-search' && c.actorId === 'amara' && c.entity === 'request' && c.action === 'asked')`, where `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the ask for an update was not saved as an open ask and logged.
- _Note:_ The table compares: one line of story per goal, Details to open it.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=table` in the demo.
- **Check:** The story row (`.story-row`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `tall <= 60`, where `const row = p.locator('.story-row').first()`; `const tall = await row.evaluate((r) => r.getBoundingClientRect().height)`. Else it says: a table story row is {Math.round(tall)}px tall before it is opened.
- **Step.** Press the “Details” button in the story row (`.story-row`).
- **Check:** (`finish`) the dl (`dl`) in the story row (`.story-row`) is visible (else: Details does not open the story).
- _Note:_ One press for the goals that need attention, on any screen (the switch, goals spec 2.1).
- **Step.** Press the attention switch (`.attention-switch:visible`).
- **Check:** “N need attention:” is shown (else: the Needs attention switch did not narrow the goals).
- _Note:_ New goal with one left unpublished: picked up where it stopped, saying so, with "Start a new one" (OB1).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “Half-written goal” into a field.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Picked up the goal you hadn’t published.” is shown (else: New goal reopens the old draft without saying so).
- **Step.** Press the “Start a new one” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Discard it” button.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `(await p.getByRole('textbox').first().inputValue()) === ''`. Else it says: Start a new one kept the old draft.
- Close this browser.
